cover.title:
THE BUG THAT
FOOLED THE FBI
FOR 7 YEARS

segments.text: In nineteen forty five, Soviet schoolchildren gave the American ambassador a carved wooden eagle.
It hung in his Moscow office for seven years.
Inside was a listening device with no battery and no wires. Nobody found it.
Your rental host does not need Soviet engineering. A thirty dollar camera works just fine.
Point your phone around the room. Four sensors find what your eyes miss.

cta.text: Check the room before you unpack.
